review_candidates.title: English customer service agent - Chat Account
review_candidates.description: Company Description ETISAL International Group is a leading Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) company serving clients across the Middle and Far East. The organization focuses on delivering high value-based, customized, and innovative outsourcing solutions tailored to each client’s unique business needs. With strong attention to cultural nuances and industry best practices, ETISAL International supports partners in enhancing their customer experience and concentrating on core business activities. The company is committed to transparency, flexibility, integrity, and continuous improvement in management and operations. Its teams leverage modern technologies and proven practices to consistently exceed client expectations. Role Description The English Customer Support Agent – Chat Account is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi. The agent will handle real-time chat conversations with customers, respond to inquiries, troubleshoot basic issues, and provide clear, accurate information about services and processes. Responsibilities include maintaining a professional tone, following established scripts and guidelines, documenting interactions, and escalating complex cases to the appropriate teams when needed. The agent will also update customer records, monitor multiple chat queues, and collaborate with colleagues and supervisors to ensure service level targets are met. Consistent adherence to quality standards, data privacy, and company policies is expected. Qualifications Strong English communication skills, including clear written expression and effective reading comprehension. Customer service skills such as patience, empathy, problem-solving, and the ability to manage difficult or high-volume interactions. Basic technical proficiency with chat platforms, CRM systems, and common office software. Attention to detail and accuracy in documenting customer interactions and following procedures. Ability to work on-site in Qesm El Maadi on rotating shifts, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as required. Previous experience in customer support, contact centers, or BPO environments is an advantage. High school diploma or equivalent; post-secondary education in business, communication, or related fields is beneficial. Reliable time management, adaptability to structured workflows, and commitment to meeting performance targets.

review_candidates.title: Biomedical Equipment Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description We suggest you enter details here. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role for a Biomedical Equipment Specialist located in Cairo. The Biomedical Equipment Specialist will be responsible for conducting regular maintenance and repair of medical equipment, ensuring optimal functionality and the safety of medical devices. The role includes promptly troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, performing inspections, testing equipment for accuracy, and keeping detailed service records. Additionally, the specialist will collaborate with medical staff to ensure equipment supports optimal patient care. Qualifications Proficiency in Equipment Maintenance, Equipment Repair, and troubleshooting techniques for various biomedical devices. Knowledge of Medical Equipment and its functionalities, including the usage of diagnostic tools. Experience in Field Service, including the ability to perform on-site equipment evaluations and repairs. Background in Military Training or a similar technical, hands-on discipline is advantageous. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent technical certification in Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field is preferred. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent communication and teamwork abilities for collaborative settings with healthcare professionals. Ability to stay up-to-date with biomedical advancements and technologies.
